anthropic_family.label: Anthropic Family
anthropic_family.description: Routes across the Claude model family: Haiku for simple queries, Sonnet for medium, Opus for complex, Opus at high thinking for reasoning.

gemini_family.label: Gemini Family
gemini_family.description: Routes across the Gemini model family: Flash Lite 2.5 for simple queries, Flash Lite 3.1 for medium, Flash 3.7 for complex, Pro 3.1 for reasoning-heavy requests.

lite.label: Lite
lite.description: Cost-optimized routing across providers: DeepSeek V4 Flash for simple queries, Muse Spark 1.2 for medium, Kimi K3 for complex, Claude Opus 5 for reasoning-heavy requests. An LLM classifier with the agentic rubric assigns tiers.

openai_family.label: OpenAI Family
openai_family.description: Routes across the GPT model family: gpt-5.4-nano for simple queries, gpt-5.4-mini for medium, gpt-5.4 for complex, o3 for reasoning-heavy requests.
